note: Pinned reading baseline for the default FRIDAY voice on core/fixtures/voice-eval/tts-mixed-script.json: mean of two runs on a loaded 4-core CPU box (load 4 to 7), seed not fixed, so a run moves by about 0.02 CER per stratum. kernel/tts_eval.py reading fails only when a stratum's CER rises more than the margin above these numbers. Numbers are the recogniser's read-back, not listening: the owner's ears decide the rest.

ears.english: faster-whisper small (int8, CPU), used for English and Roman Hinglish
ears.hindi: AI4Bharat IndicConformer Hindi int8 (the Hindi ear), used for Hindi and Devanagari Hinglish
